limits: Whole-trajectory tests couple semantic random outcomes; stochastic mechanics retain separate distribution/support tests.
Live opponent information remains estimated where Showdown hides it; coupled tests start from complete controlled states.
Changing teams, implementation fingerprints, simulator or observation schema invalidates training clearance.
No claim of SOTA, improved winrate, or a trained new checkpoint follows from mechanics parity.
